hidden-valleys-expedition.title: Kaza to Mudh
hidden-valleys-expedition.description: The wonderful cycling ride to the last village, Mudh, in the Pin Valley. It will cross several villages in the valley, such as Gulling, Mikkim, and Sagnam.

hidden-valleys-expedition.title: Mudh to Pin valley Nation park then Phukchang
hidden-valleys-expedition.description: This hidden village in the valley and another getaway to experience nature and the high mountains. Meeting locals working in the fields to harvest green peas.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Chandigarh to Sangla Valley
cold-desert-expedition.description: Travel from Chandigarh into Kinnaur and the Baspa River valley. Settle into the accommodation and meet the team for an introduction to the expedition.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Explore the Baspa River Valley
cold-desert-expedition.description: A day around the Baspa River valley before the longer cycling stages. The exact activity and schedule will be confirmed with the final itinerary.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Batseri to Chitkul and return
cold-desert-expedition.description: Ride from Batseri towards Chitkul and return, following the Baspa River valley. Overnight near Batseri.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Batseri to Kanam
cold-desert-expedition.description: Continue through the Kinnaur region towards Kanam. Final route logistics and cycling distance will be confirmed before departure.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Kanam to Nako
cold-desert-expedition.description: Travel deeper into the high-altitude landscape and reach Nako, known for its traditional village setting and monastery.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Nako to Gue to Tabo
cold-desert-expedition.description: Continue into Spiti, with a visit to Gue and its Buddhist monk mummy shrine before reaching Tabo and its historic monastery.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Tabo to Dhankar to Kaza
cold-desert-expedition.description: Ride towards Kaza through Spiti's dramatic dry landscapes, with a visit to Dhankar Monastery. Any hike or additional stop depends on conditions and timing.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Kaza to Kibber and Chicham, onward to Losar
cold-desert-expedition.description: Explore Spiti's high villages around Kibber and Chicham, with the route continuing towards Losar via Kiato. The precise riding and vehicle-support plan will be confirmed with the final route sheet.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Losar to Chandratal
cold-desert-expedition.description: Travel towards Chandratal across high mountain terrain and the Kunzum La area. The final cycling distance and overnight arrangements are to be confirmed.

cold-desert-expedition.title: Chandratal to Manali
cold-desert-expedition.description: Transfer from Chandratal to Manali. The expedition concludes in Manali; departure timing and any onward connections should be arranged after confirming the transfer schedule.

zanskar-on-two-wheels.title: a
zanskar-on-two-wheels.description: Zanskar is a remote, high-altitude sub-district and valley located in the Union Territory of Ladakh, India, and also refers to a science-backed health and wellness brand
